cyber-security-fundamentals.title: Cyber Security Fundamentals Every Engineering Team Should Know
cyber-security-fundamentals.excerpt: Core ideas that help you reason about risk, trust boundaries, and defense in depth before you ship your next mobile release.

mobile-threat-modeling.title: Mobile Threat Modeling Without the Spreadsheet Fatigue
mobile-threat-modeling.excerpt: A practical way to capture assets, adversaries, and entry points so your backlog reflects real security work.

static-analysis-mastery.excerpt: How to tune rules, reduce false positives, and connect scanner output to owners and SLAs.

cicd-security-gates.excerpt: Thresholds, exceptions, and reporting that keep velocity high without hiding critical issues.

owasp-mobile-top-10-overview.title: OWASP Mobile Top 10: A Field-Friendly Refresher

masvs-from-theory-to-practice.title: MASVS: From Theory to Testable Controls

api-security-mobile-context.title: API Security in the Mobile Context
api-security-mobile-context.excerpt: Tokens, pinning, transport assumptions, and what your backend peers need from the app team.

reverse-engineering-basics.title: Reverse Engineering Basics for App Developers
reverse-engineering-basics.excerpt: What attackers see when they open your binary—and how to reduce easy wins.

secure-sdlc-for-mobile.title: Secure SDLC Patterns for Mobile Teams
secure-sdlc-for-mobile.excerpt: Design reviews, dependency hygiene, and release checklists that scale beyond one hero engineer.

pentest-vs-static-analysis.title: Penetration Testing vs Static Analysis: Complementary, Not Competing
pentest-vs-static-analysis.excerpt: When to invest in each, how findings overlap, and how to avoid duplicate work.

data-protection-mobile-apps.title: Data Protection on Device and in Transit
data-protection-mobile-apps.excerpt: Encryption, storage APIs, and logging pitfalls that show up again and again in reviews.

key-management-best-practices.title: Key Management Practices That Survive App Updates
key-management-best-practices.excerpt: Rotation, attestation, and secure enclaves—without turning every release into a fire drill.

zero-trust-mobile-endpoints.title: Zero Trust Thinking for Mobile Endpoints
zero-trust-mobile-endpoints.excerpt: Device posture, session lifetimes, and continuous verification in consumer-grade apps.

incident-response-app-breaches.title: Incident Response When a Mobile App Is in Scope
incident-response-app-breaches.excerpt: Forensics constraints, user communication, and what to log before you need it.

security-champions-program.title: Building a Security Champions Program That Lasts
security-champions-program.excerpt: Lightweight rituals, office hours, and recognition that keep security visible between audits.

roadmap-2025-mobile-security.title: Roadmap 2025: Mobile Security Priorities
roadmap-2025-mobile-security.excerpt: Supply chain, AI-assisted code, and privacy expectations shaping the next wave of assessments.
